title: Tailwise Training Satisfaction Guarantee Terms: Free Repeat of a Completed Course
content:
**The Tailwise Training Satisfaction Guarantee.** Where the course offers a free repeat, a dog that attended at least the course's required share of the scheduled sessions, makeups counting, may repeat the same course free as a guarantee repeat enrollment, up to the course's free-repeat allowance per original enrollment. A guarantee repeat must start no later than the course's free-repeat window in days after the original course's completion date. The window is counted in calendar days from the original enrollment's completion date, that date being day 0.

The required attendance share, window and allowance, and whether a course offers the free repeat at all, are each course's own figures in the Tailwise Training Satisfaction Guarantee schedule.

### What is counted

- **Attendance.** Sessions the dog attended on the original enrollment plus the makeup sessions it attended for that enrollment, measured against the course's scheduled sessions.
- **Repeats used.** The guarantee repeat enrollments already made from that original enrollment, over its whole life.
- **Completion date.** The date the original enrollment closed as completed, as shown on the company's record of that original enrollment; the repeat is tied to the original enrollment it repeats.

### Window boundary (hypothetical dates, on a course whose window is 90 days)

Original course completed on March 1, which is day 0. Counting calendar days, March 31 is day 30, April 30 is day 60 and May 30 is day 90.

| Repeat class start | Day count | No later than day 90? |
|---|---|---|
| May 29 | 89 | Yes |
| May 30 | 90 | Yes, on the boundary |
| May 31 | 91 | No |

### Attendance cases (hypothetical, on a 6-session course requiring 100%)

| Original enrollment | Counted attendance | 100% met? |
|---|---|---|
| 6 sessions attended | 6 of 6 | Yes |
| 5 attended and 1 excused session made up in another class | 6 of 6 | Yes |
| 5 attended and 1 forfeited | 5 of 6 | No |

### Points of judgement

- The repeat is of the **same course**, and it is an enrollment of the guarantee repeat kind tied to the original enrollment.
- The allowance counts per original enrollment: once the allowance has been used, that original enrollment supports no further free repeat.
- Every element must hold together: the course offers the free repeat, the attendance share is reached, the allowance is not exhausted, and the repeat starts within the window.
